summary: One section of a dga-accordion: a heading with a toggle button and a labelled region holding the projected content.

inputs.name: expanded
inputs.description: Whether the section is open; two-way [(expanded)] to open it from code or follow it.

inputs.name: disabled
inputs.description: Disables the header button; the section cannot be toggled or focused.

outputs.name: expandedChange
outputs.description: The new state when the user toggles the section or single mode closes it.

slots.description: The section body (translated content), hidden while collapsed.

a11y: The header is a native button inside role=heading (aria-level from the accordion, 3 alone), with aria-expanded and aria-controls pointing at the panel. The panel is role=region labelled by the header and hidden while collapsed. The chevron is decorative and turns over when open; it needs no mirroring in RTL.
